# Nexus-Hub

> Modular skill and instruction library that augments AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Codex) with enterprise-grade workflows, 134 curated skills, and cross-platform installers.

## Installation

### One command (recommended)

macOS / Linux (paste into a terminal): `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bendourthe/Nexus-Hub/main/install.sh | bash` (no curl? use `wget -qO-`)
Windows (paste into PowerShell): `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bendourthe/Nexus-Hub/main/install.ps1 | iex`

The command downloads the catalog and runs the installer with no prompts, copying skills, hooks, and templates to your user profile (`~/.claude/skills/`, `~/.gemini/`, etc.) across every supported assistant it detects. Run `nexus-hub upgrade` later to update in place. Already cloned the repo? `./install.sh` / `install.bat` still work.

### Manual

Copy skill directories from `catalog/skills/<category>/<skill-name>/` to your project's `.claude/skills/` or `~/.claude/skills/`.

## Content Types

- **skill**: Behavioral instruction for an AI coding agent. Entry file: `SKILL.md`. Triggers automatically from context.
- **command**: User-invocable slash command. Entry file: Markdown with YAML frontmatter. Invoked with `/command-name`.
- **workflow**: Ordered chain of skills for a specific goal. Defined in `data/workflows.json`.
- **bundle**: Curated skill collection for a developer role. Defined in `data/bundles.json`.
- **template**: Base AI instruction file for a platform/language. Installed to `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `copilot-instructions.md`, or `AGENTS.md`.
- **hook**: Shell script that runs inside Claude Code sessions (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop events).

## Slash Commands (16, plus 3 permanent aliases)

Most commands take a scope as the first argument (e.g. `/review security`); run a command bare to get a scope menu. The cheatsheet is generated at runtime from the installed command files (`/skills list` or `/commands`), so it always matches the commands actually present.

/compare       Gap analysis vs an external repo / article / local path; reverse-engineer-first adoption plan; chains to /plan
/describe      Structured description of any directory (scopes: full, structure, deps, architecture, onboarding)
/implement     Implement one plan phase end-to-end (review, code, lint, test, troubleshoot, post-phase docs + commit); final phase runs release readiness
/memory        Audit, prune, and manage CLAUDE.md and memory files across the project
/plan          Goal-gated, phased plan (scopes: feature, goals, new, refactor, from-comparison, todos, issues)
/presentify    Turn one or more documents (PDF / Word / Excel / PowerPoint) into a single self-contained, offline, interactive HTML presentation; local-only parsing, inline charts, no external requests
/research      Deep multi-source research, report compilation, and document export (.docx / slide deck / Markdown)
/review        Read-only review (scopes: full, quality, coverage, security, pentest, changes, deps, sbom, skill-scan)
/route         Detect the platform, enumerate models live, and route a task or plan phase to the cheapest capable model + reasoning effort
/session       Resume where you left off, wrap up cleanly, or write a session-history document
/setup         Bootstrap a project: scaffold CLAUDE.md, structure, .gitignore, README, optional pre-commit review hook
/skills        Browse, search, create, import, and security-scan the skill + command catalog
/spec          Clarify a spec, analyze a feature directory for coverage / consistency, or author / amend the project constitution
/test          Drive coverage to threshold (tiers: unit, integration, e2e, ci, tdd, all)
/update        Sync + ship (scopes: docs, devlog, version, changelog, refactor, config, commit, release)
/usage         Check Claude Code usage limits and model-switching recommendations

Permanent aliases:

/commands      Alias for /skills list (the command cheatsheet)
/commit        Alias for /update commit (structured commit message for staged changes)
/constitution  Alias for /spec constitution (author / amend the project constitution)

## Hooks (10 runtime hooks for Claude Code)

PreToolUse:  git-guardrails.sh (Bash), secret-scan.sh (Write/Edit), large-file-guard.sh (Write), escalation-trigger.sh (Write/Edit)
PostToolUse: auto-format-on-write.sh (Write/Edit), lint-on-write.sh (Write/Edit)
Stop:        usage-display.sh, notify-on-complete.sh, session-summary.sh

## Platform Support

| Platform | Config File | Skills | Templates |
|----------|-------------|--------|-----------|
| Claude Code | CLAUDE.md + .claude/skills/ | Yes | base-claude.md |
| Gemini | .gemini/GEMINI.md | Yes | base-gemini.md |
| GitHub Copilot | .github/copilot-instructions.md | No | coding-snippets/ |
| Codex / Jules / Cursor / Aider | AGENTS.md | No | base-codex.md |

## Key Files

catalog/skills/           134 skill directories organized by category
catalog/commands/         16 slash commands plus 3 permanent aliases
catalog/hooks/            10 runtime hook shell scripts
templates/ai-instructions/ Base instruction templates for each platform
scripts/installer.ps1     Windows installer (PowerShell, no runtime required)
scripts/installer.sh      macOS/Linux installer (Bash, no runtime required)
scripts/generate_report.py Word/PowerPoint report generator (Python 3.8+)
data/skills.json          Machine-readable catalog of all 134 skills
data/workflows.json       18 goal-based workflow definitions
data/bundles.json         11 role-based bundle definitions
extensions/claude-usage-monitor/  VS Code extension: Claude Code usage monitoring
extensions/codex-usage-monitor/   VS Code extension: Codex (ChatGPT) usage monitoring
